finalText:
**Build passes now, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs, both from the bundler's shape change:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw when a flag was `undefined`, since the new config loader stopped defaulting unset flags to `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled, same as `false`.

The rest of the noise, deprecation notices and dedupe lines, was cosmetic.

Next: nothing, build is green.
